B14_00.process: Restraining the complement cascade so it spares host tissue.
B14_00.disease: Hereditary angioedema, complement-mediated haemolysis, and inflammatory kidney and eye disease.

B14_01.process: Sensorimotor gating that filters redundant sensory input to dampen startle.
B14_01.tissue: Brain, especially striatal dopaminergic and glutamatergic neurons.

B14_02.process: Repulsive axon guidance that steers growing axons away from wrong targets.
B14_02.disease: Wiring defects, misrouted projections, and failed regrowth after nerve injury.
B14_02.tissue: Developing neurons of spinal cord, forebrain and sensory systems.

B14_03.process: Switching off the IRE1 branch of the ER stress response.
B14_03.tissue: Secretory cells; most cell types under ER stress.

B14_04.process: Restraining Th1-type, interferon-gamma-driven T cell immunity.
B14_04.disease: Autoimmunity, chronic inflammatory disease, and weakened antitumour immunity.
B14_04.tissue: T helper cells and other immune cells.

B14_05.process: Inhibitory signalling that limits cytotoxic T cell killing.
B14_05.disease: Autoimmunity, transplant rejection, tumour and viral immune evasion.
B14_05.tissue: Cytotoxic T cells; also the maternal-fetal interface.

B14_06.process: Limiting the strength and duration of TNF inflammatory and death signalling.
B14_06.disease: Chronic inflammation, insulin resistance, infection and cancer.
B14_06.tissue: Immune cells and most cell types responding to TNF.

B14_07.process: Braking directed migration of endothelial cells during new vessel growth.
B14_07.disease: Tumour angiogenesis and disorganised, leaky vessel growth.

B14_08.process: Restraining T helper cell differentiation toward the Th2 lineage.

B14_09.process: Limiting endothelial responses to VEGF to keep angiogenesis proportionate.
B14_09.tissue: Endothelial cells; retina and wound vasculature.

B14_10.process: Negative feedback limiting fibroblast growth factor receptor signalling.
B14_10.disease: Developmental skeletal disorders and FGFR-driven cancers.
B14_10.tissue: Developing limb, skeleton, lung, kidney and blood vessels.

B14_11.process: Negative feedback that resolves IL-6 cytokine signalling.
B14_11.disease: Rheumatoid arthritis, cytokine storm and inflammation-associated cancer.
B14_11.tissue: Immune cells and liver acute-phase responders.

B14_12.process: Braking monocyte migration toward inflammatory chemokine gradients.
B14_12.disease: Atherosclerosis, fibrosis and prolonged inflammatory tissue damage.

B14_13.process: Limiting cytokine production by activated T cells.
B14_13.disease: Autoimmunity, inflammatory disease, and tumour immune evasion.
B14_13.tissue: T cells, including regulatory and helper T cells.

B14_14.process: Damping VEGF receptor signalling to restrain blood vessel growth.
B14_14.disease: Tumour angiogenesis, retinopathy and vascular malformation.

B14_15.process: Braking granulocyte migration so inflammation can resolve.
B14_15.disease: Sepsis, arthritis and chronic lung disease.

B14_16.process: Switching off the PERK branch of the ER stress response.

B14_17.process: Limiting cellular responses to TGF-beta signalling.
B14_17.disease: Organ fibrosis, excessive scarring and cancer.

B14_18.process: Protecting cells from apoptosis during ER stress.
B14_18.tissue: Pancreatic beta cells, plasma cells, osteoblasts and neurons.

B14_19.process: Blocking directed migration of vascular smooth muscle cells.
B14_19.tissue: Vascular smooth muscle cells of arteries.

B14_20.process: Switching off bone morphogenetic protein signalling.
B14_20.disease: Heterotopic ossification, sclerosing bone disease and iron overload.
B14_20.tissue: Bone, joints, blood vessels and liver.

B14_21.process: Restraining complement and antibody effector responses against host tissue.
B14_21.disease: Atypical haemolytic uraemic syndrome, macular degeneration and lupus-like autoimmunity.
B14_21.tissue: Blood, B cells and myeloid cells.

B14_22.process: Damping chemokine signalling that guides leukocyte migration.
B14_22.disease: Persistent inflammation; links to axon guidance and vascular patterning defects.

B14_23.process: Restraining T helper cell differentiation toward the Th17 lineage.
B14_23.disease: Psoriasis, inflammatory bowel disease and other autoimmunity.

B14_24.process: Braking macrophage migration toward sites of injury or infection.
B14_24.disease: Persistent inflammation and impaired wound healing.

B14_25.process: Limiting ER-associated degradation of misfolded proteins.
B14_25.tissue: Most cell types; kidney proximal tubule.
